text: On behalf of the Student Union, I am honored to extend a cordial invitation for you to serve as a judge in our upcoming English Speech Contest.
The event is scheduled to take place in the University Hall from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. next Friday, with the theme of Cross-Cultural Communication.
Several meaningful sessions have been arranged, including student speeches and live feedback.
Knowing your keen interest in language teaching, we believe not only can your insights inspire all contestants, but they will also elevate the quality of the competition.
It would be deeply appreciated if you could accept our invitation and inform us of your availability before Wednesday.
